title: Ashbound Alpha
author: Nora Vale
description: A banished wolf returns to a divided city pack and must choose between revenge, loyalty, and the mate who remembers his real name.
longDescription: Rowan left the Ashbound pack after a fire made him look like a traitor. Years later, the same smoke rises over the river district, and Mira, the healer who once saved him, is the only person willing to follow the evidence. Their search crosses pack borders, mafia debts, and an old lunar oath that can either restore Rowan's name or destroy the city.
